findings: Complete current MDX SHA-256 is 397144c566bdaee55625eca1fcdce2615e051f08714053d631a231b3ff3c398e; all 4 declared sources passed current HTTPS access review.

The master-inventory member is 3,099,690 bytes, SHA-256 b3adb05b75a562926fd210c9bafdb27d4d7bafa2280dd43f87fcbbf1b8e6af61, 2,225 letter-size pages, unencrypted, with rotation 0.

The publisher page groups the ZIP under 2026 Certified Appraisal Rolls while physical page 1 says PRELIMINARY; this is preserved as UNRESOLVED-CONFLICT and neither label is silently normalized.

PDF extraction and OCR remain supporting or non-validating evidence only; manual render review controls visible wording.
